1.consolidated_definition: Reavivamiento. Resurgimiento de fervor religioso. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Todo parecía remitir al modelo del revival, ese culto convulsivo y pintoresco de reavivamiento religioso (El Nuevo Día, 02-05-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Revival. Resurgence of religious fervor. Raw Anglicism, infrequently used. Everything seemed to be reverting to the revival model, that convulsive and picturesque cult of religious revival (The New Day, 02-05-08)
